testResults.name: hosted-deployment-and-health-smoke
testResults.result: The workflow published the immutable image, logged in with Azure OIDC, validated and deployed infra/main.bicep, verified API and ingest image digests, and passed the private probe-safe /health smoke on commit 373dd17.

testResults.name: single-production-mutation-path
testResults.result: README documents .github/workflows/deploy-main.yml as the only repository-triggered Azure mutation path; no alternate production mutation path is documented.

decisions: The existing deploy-main workflow already satisfied the acceptance criteria, so no workflow source change was needed in this wave.
The hosted run is current deployment evidence; earlier workflow implementation remains anchored by commit df9a7be.
limitations: GitHub emitted the existing Node.js 20 action deprecation warning; all workflow jobs passed.
